text:
anya: Heads-up — just saw a spike in GPU provisioning failures in eu-west-1 after the midnight firewall patch. VMs stuck in Pending and warm-pool didn't fill. ops-bot: Alert: 3912345678 - NAT/egress policy change detected in eu-west-1 by infra-deploy (user: infra-service). Affected resources: subnet-pp-*-gpu. nora: seeing the same, provisioning API returning 502 -> failed to reach keystore endpoint (kms-replica.eu-west-1). No obvious permission errors in control plane logs. vikram: can you paste the exact deny rule id? I want to check if KMS port (TCP 443) was accidentally blocked to the keystore subnet. anya: rule id: fw-rule-7a3b. It was added at 00:12 UTC with description "restrict-egress-temp". kevin: if KMS blocked, that explains failures. GPU nodes wait for keystore handshake before starting up. Quick test — curl from a staging jump to keystore endpoint? nora: ran `curl -v https://kms-replica.eu-west-1.internal/health` from jumpbox -> connection timed out (no TLS handshake). vikram: rollback the fw-rule and re-run warm-pool? I can patch infra to remove it if infra-deploy still has the change. ops-bot: Rollback request received for fw-rule-7a3b by @vikram at 00:29 UTC. sec-qa-bot: Reminder: removing rules will change audit trail; ensure we annotate the incident for compliance. anya: agreed, annotate and include exact commit and PR. kevin: also flag: audit-logging to S3 shows a gap between 00:10-00:20 — some CloudTrail events missing for keystore calls. Could be side-effect of same policy or a logging pipeline outage. nora: checked flow logs for subnet-pp-1: they show TCP resets to kms-replica IP starting 00:11. No traffic to KMS after rule creation. vikram: rollback complete, fw-rule-7a3b removed at 00:31 UTC. Re-triggered warm-pool allocation manually. ops-bot: Warm-pool task 87612 queued; nodes started provisioning. anya: warm-pool filled for 6/8 nodes, two still failing with keystore timeouts. kevin: share kubelet logs from one failing node? nora: paste logs:
```
[00:33:05] kubelet: keystore handshake failed: dial tcp 10.12.45.9:443: connect: connection timed out
[00:33:06] system: retrying keystore auth (attempt 3)
[00:33:12] kubelet: keystore handshake failed: dial tcp 10.12.45.9:443: connect: connection timed out
```
vikram: that looks like stale conntrack entries — conntrack may still be dropping packets for established-but-now-removed rule. Suggest flushing conntrack on nodes or rotate NAT gateway. kevin: conntrack flush might require node reboot in our setup; alternative is to perform a NAT gateway failover in the VPC to reset translations. nora: NAT gateway rotation performed at 00:45 UTC, retried node provisioning. ops-bot: NAT failover executed by infra-runner (run id: 2026-3912). sec-qa-bot: Note for postmortem: KMS availability and audit gap need a blameless RCA and ticket for improved egress rule safeguards + pre-apply simulation. anya: brief status: all 8 warm-pool nodes now healthy at 00:52 UTC. provisioning errors peaked at ~120 failed attempts, now cleared. vikram: action items — (1) add a CI check to detect egress rules that would block keystore CIDRs before merging, (2) add watch to alert if keystore 443 fails across region for >1m, (3) investigate CloudTrail ingestion gap. kevin: also recommend adding a rollback TTL to temporary firewall changes (auto-revert after 15m) and a runbook step to flush conntrack / rotate NAT on rollback. nora: creating infra ticket INF-12345 with links to flow logs, PR diff, and timestamps. anya: thanks all — will draft a short postmortem and compliance note. :white_check_mark:)
